item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-10-17
item.description: China's Ministry of Commerce and Ministry of Science and Technology issue Announcement No. 48 proposing export controls on 23 AI technologies with an explicit carve-out for public domain and open-source releases; concurrently, Moonshot AI's confidential Hong Kong IPO preparation encounters escalating governance friction through a $700 million founder-equity dispute with Recurrent.ai.
